CAMPANHA.NAO_RECEBER: Mark the contact as “does not receive”
CAMPANHA.NAO_RECEBER_DICA: The contact leaves every campaign and gets no more outbound messages. You can undo it on the contact.
CAMPANHA.SO_RECORRENTE: Sending a campaign only works in an automation that runs on its own, on a schedule. With a conversation or card trigger, each run would send the same campaign again, so it can't be saved.
CAMPANHA.SEM_CAIXA: This account has no official WhatsApp inbox.
CAMPANHA.SEM_MODELO: This inbox has no approved template that fits a campaign.
CAMPANHA.MODELO_SUMIU: The template {nome} is no longer approved in this inbox. Choose another one.
CAMPANHA.CUSTO_PROPAGANDA: Marketing templates cost more on Meta, charged per message.
CAMPANHA.VARIAVEL_DICA: The campaign goes to many people at once, so write fixed text.
CAMPANHA.ETIQUETAS_DICA: Whoever has one of these labels when it sends gets it. Adding or removing the label puts the person in or out of the campaign.
CAMPANHA.SEM_ETIQUETAS: This account has no labels yet.
CAMPANHA.SEM_ETIQUETAS_DICA: Optional. Anyone with one of these labels is left out, even with an audience label. E.g.: everyone except who already bought.
CAMPANHA.FRASE_NAO_RECEBER: Mark the contact as “does not receive”
